review_description: Quick, easy, tidy.Kept in contact throughout the rebate claims and helped me through it.Organised an engineer to sign off on feed in to the grid

The communication we had was very poor we didnt get a quote untill said it hadnt arrived . We paid a deposite and received no reciept or comformation when they were going ahead.Allmost two months later the pannels were installed. We have not got a final payment  reciept only a warranty for the inverter which we have not had turned on yet  as we have been told we have to install a smart meter and dont know how that will affect our bill and have been told bye our electricity company they are going to put up our rates because we have sola.So i wish we would have researched it alot better. Thinking we are doing something  good for the enviroment and we pay for it in many ways.
